name: globe
title: Globe
description: A sphere of evenly spaced dots turns slowly, the far side faint, with a few brighter markers for real places (lat/lon). WebGL points; a CSS dotted disc stands in everywhere else.

meta.reducedMotion: The globe, still, facing the first marker.
meta.useWhen: The business is genuinely about places on Earth (shipping, a diaspora, offices in named cities, a travel route), and the markers are real.
meta.avoidWhen: As a generic "global" or "scale" signal; with invented markers; on pages that already run WebGL; at small sizes (the dots turn to noise).
